about: People bring up a change and who they believe caused it (M4-05). The change comes from an event the speaker learned of; the cause from what they heard: a blame they were told, the record they saw, or, with neither, someone they know holds a public role when their temperament runs to blaming authority.

told.text: From what I heard, {{who}} was behind it.

assumed.text: I'd bet {{who}} had a hand in it.

unknown.text: I don't know who's behind it.
